text:
maya: Kicking off blue->green traffic shift for router service: v2.6.1 -> v2.7.0. Plan: ramp to 60% green over 20m, then 100% after 30m if stable. Change window: 30m quiet. Release notes: https://redwood-internal/release/rv2.7.0 :party:
rob: ack. health checks up? any additional preflight checks?
infra-bot: prereq checks passed: all nodes healthy, KV cache primed, sticky-session table size normal.
deploy-bot: deploy started by maya. step=0 -> initiating weighted routing session id=wr-20260321-1
maya: SLO triggers: if p95 > 300ms OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> pause and evaluate rollback. Watch EU first.
leo: will run synthetic probes from eu-west1 and report every 2m.
deploy-bot: step=1 weight=20% green, 80% blue -> timestamp=1711083516
leo: probe: 20% green, p95=180ms, err=0.12% (eu-west1). All clear so far.
rob: starting traffic flood test on canary path (small spike sim).
deploy-bot: step=2 weight=40% green -> timestamp=1711083576
sre-oncall: seeing slight p50 increase in eu-west1 (from 45ms -> 90ms) but p95 still < 300ms. err at 0.18%.
leo: probe: 40% green, p95=310ms, err=0.6% in eu-west1 — crossing SLO.
maya: pausing ramp. rolling back to 30% green and pining weight at 30% while we debug.
deploy-bot: override accepted by maya. step=adjust weight=30% green -> timestamp=1711083660
rob: noted. can someone pin session-affinity to blue for EU cohort? suspect cookie-handling change in v2.7.0.
leo: quick test shows Set-Cookie path changed on green. will open a short hotfix PR now.
infra-bot: temp routing command to pin: ```routectl set-weight --route router-main --cohort eu-west1 --weight green=30```. Use with care.
maya: applied infra-bot command to pin EU cohort to 30% while we ship a fix.
sre-oncall: monitoring. overall traffic stable, global p95 within bounds, EU isolated.
rob: when hotfix is up, we can re-run warmup then continue ramp. prefer warmup for 10m at 50% EU before full shift.
leo: hotfix PR merged -> image pushed with cookie fix (v2.7.0+fix). rolling deploy to green nodes in eu region.
deploy-bot: green eu image update detected. step=green-redeploy eu -> timestamp=1711083812
leo: synthetic probe after redeploy: 50% green warmup -> p95=140ms, err=0.08% (eu-west1). good to resume.
maya: resume ramp: move EU cohort to 50% for 10m, then global ramp to 100% if stable.
deploy-bot: step=resume weight=50% green eu, global weight still 30% -> timestamp=1711083870
sre-oncall: watching for 5m. if error_rate > 0.3% for 5m -> rollback to v2.6.1.
leo: all probes healthy at +6m. recommending proceed to global 100% over next 15m.
maya: proceeding. final command: ```routectl gradual-shift --route router-main --target green=100 --duration 15m```
deploy-bot: final ramp started -> expected completion timestamp=1711084800
infra-bot: note: created rollback ticket #ROLL-4621 and pinned v2.6.1 images in registry as a safe fallback.
rob: thumbs up :thumbsup: great coordination. will update release notes with the cookie fix mention.
maya: closing the thread when deploy-bot posts completion. thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: traffic shift complete. outcome=success, final_version=v2.7.0, rollback_triggered=false, notes="EU cookie fix applied during warmup" -> timestamp=1711083996
